prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Tobias Reyne for the job below.

About the freelancer: 7 years experience; skills: JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, full stack, HTML and CSS

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Redesign and Optimize a Checkout Page in Funnelish.
I have a checkout page on Funnelish, but I want it to be redesigned. The redesigning is simple, just to re-arrange some texts and image elements Second is, the page scrolls to the right on mobile, as if there is a space there. I need this fixed, as it is affecting my conversion. I need this done as soon as possible, so the earlier you can start, the better. Make sure you understand before submitting a proposal. I don’t want time wasters. Thank you.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Serverless image pipeline
client: Lumen Photo Co.
client_industry: media
start: 2024-06
end: 2024-08
engagement: fixed
stack:
- AWS Lambda
- AWS S3
- Sharp
- Node.js
- CloudFront
built: Uploads trigger a Lambda that creates web sizes and watermarks, served through
  a CDN.
metrics:
- 2.3M images processed
- hosting costs down 61%

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Serverless image pipeline (p14).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate, hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and improving web interfaces and application flows.

I understand exactly what you need: a quick redesign of your Funnelish checkout page by rearranging the text and image elements, plus a fix for the mobile scrolling issue where the page shifts to the right because of extra space. Since this affects conversion, I’d treat the layout bug as a priority and make sure the page behaves correctly on mobile as soon as possible.

I’ve worked across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, so I’m comfortable handling both front-end layout issues and the kind of responsive behavior that can hurt a checkout experience. For a recent project, I built a serverless image pipeline for Lumen Photo Co. where uploads triggered a Lambda to create web sizes and watermarks, served through a CDN. That system processed 2.3M images and reduced hosting costs by 61%.

For your Funnelish page, I’d focus on:
- Reworking the section order and visual hierarchy so the checkout looks cleaner and more effective
- Identifying the source of the horizontal scroll on mobile
- Removing any overflow or spacing issue causing the right-side shift
- Testing the page on mobile to confirm the fix holds up across screen sizes

I work carefully, but I also move fast when a project needs immediate attention. If you want someone who can understand the request clearly, avoid wasted time, and get this done quickly, I’m ready to start right away.

If you’d like, send over the Funnelish page details and I can jump in.
